Four merged PRs changed a line containing `doFilterInternal` under `web/src/main/java` since 2026-04-14, on the main line up to the pinned head (`master`, 5eb8cba):

1. **#6673** (TRUNK-6824), merged 2026-10-12 (+03:00). Added `RepeatedSlashFilter.doFilterInternal`, a new file. @file:{openmrs-core::web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/RepeatedSlashFilter.java:50-50}
2. **#6680** (TRUNK-6826), merged 2026-10-13 (+03:00). Added `TrailingSlashFilter.doFilterInternal`, a new file. @file:{openmrs-core::web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/TrailingSlashFilter.java:54-54}
3. **#6544** (TRUNK-6799), merged 2026-10-08 (+02:00). Removed `OpenmrsFilter.doFilterInternal` when the file was deleted, and added `OpenmrsSecurityContextFilter.doFilterInternal`, which supersedes it. @file:{openmrs-core::web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/security/OpenmrsSecurityContextFilter.java:54-54}
4. **#6505** (TRUNK-6705), merged 2026-08-26 (-04:00). Rewrote the `GZIPFilter.doFilterInternal` signature, so one line was removed and one added. @file:{openmrs-core::web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/GZIPFilter.java:48-48}

Other `doFilterInternal` lines under `web/src/main/java` (CookieClearingFilter, OpenSessionInViewFilter) were not changed in that window. The other filter changes in the window (for example #6434, #6555, #6654) left the `doFilterInternal` lines untouched.

Caveats:
- I compared the net diff from 22a4bae~1 to master. A line added and then removed inside the window would cancel out and not appear, so I would not rule that out.
- I took each PR number from the squash-merge subject and used the commit date as the merge date.
- The `get_diff` tool rejected the full SHA for 2d32d20 in one call, so I used short SHAs for those two lookups.
- I could not read the saved diff output under `tool-results`, so the diff was checked file by file.
